title: Oven baked pasta
ingredients: 400g mix frozen veggies (peas, corn, carrots, cauliflower, broccoli, green beans...)
instructions: Cook the pasta until al dente.
Grate the cheese, and mix it alongside the veggies, spices and sour cream together.
Spread over a baking tray and bake at 200C for about 30 min.
